definitions.explanation: Words or actions meant to frighten someone into doing what one wants.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{脅|おど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乗|の}らない→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I won't give in to threats like that.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脅|おど}しだった。
examples.english: His words were just an empty threat.

examples.japanese: {脅|おど}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何通|なんつう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I received several threatening emails, so I went to the police.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脅|おど}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to threaten, to intimidate
- {脅|おど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{屈|くっ}する→屈する：09142_kussuru⟧: to give in to threats
- {脅|おど}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}らない→乗る：00511_noru⟧: not to be intimidated
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脅|おど}し: an empty threat
- {脅|おど}し⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧: threatening words

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脅迫|きょうはく}→脅迫：27205_kyouhaku⟧: the formal and legal term (blackmail, criminal intimidation); {脅|おど}し is the everyday word
